datasets.provider: ESA WorldCover via Microsoft Planetary Computer
datasets.source: ESA WorldCover public COG sampled via Microsoft Planetary Computer
datasets.acquisitionMethod: HTTP range-read of provider COG over exact persisted finding geometries
datasets.licenseNotes: Provider product terms apply; VIGIA records no broader reuse claim.
datasets.projection: Native tile CRS sampled into detector geometry
datasets.transformation: Nearest-neighbour categorical sampling; per-class pixel fractions within geometry
datasets.spatialJoinRule: Pixels whose centres fall within the exact persisted finding geometry
datasets.temporalJoinRule: Static 2021 land-cover reference compared with 2025/2026 detector scenes; temporal mismatch retained as a limitation
knownLimitations: Original COG bytes were range-read and not locally archived, so raw checksums remain measurement debt.
Product shares Sentinel-2 lineage with the detector input.
datasets.referenceDependency: Derived from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2; not independent of VIGIA Sentinel-2 inputs.
datasets.qualification: Geometry-bound land-cover plausibility reference, not expert hazard truth.

datasets.provider: Copernicus DEM via Microsoft Planetary Computer
datasets.source: Copernicus DEM public COG sampled via Microsoft Planetary Computer
datasets.acquisitionMethod: HTTP range-read of provider COG over finding geometry and 150 m context buffer
datasets.licenseNotes: Provider product terms apply; VIGIA records no broader reuse claim.
datasets.projection: Native tile CRS sampled into detector geometry + 150m buffer
datasets.transformation: Terrain summary from geometry-bound GLO-30 samples
datasets.spatialJoinRule: Finding geometry plus 150 m context buffer
datasets.temporalJoinRule: Static terrain; no event-time join asserted
knownLimitations: Original COG bytes were range-read and not locally archived, so raw checksums remain measurement debt.
Terrain context does not validate land-cover class or intervention efficacy.
datasets.referenceDependency: Terrain reference is physically independent of the optical vegetation-change decision but does not validate fuel class.
datasets.qualification: Terrain context only; not land-cover or fire-behavior truth.

datasets.licenseNotes: Copernicus data terms apply; catalogue metadata archived for reproducibility.
datasets.transformation: Collection discovery only; no raster transformation or finding join performed
datasets.temporalJoinRule: Reserved for a future frozen pre-event versus later-burn campaign
knownLimitations: Catalogue discovery is not a joined burned-area validation corpus.
300 m burned-area products are coarser than the PREVENT detector.
datasets.referenceDependency: Coarse burned-area products use satellite observations and cannot independently prove PREVENT efficacy.
datasets.qualification: Catalogue acquired for a future no-leakage historical campaign; not joined to current 2026 findings.

datasets.acquisitionMethod: Overpass JSON acquisition archived before validation
datasets.licenseNotes: OpenStreetMap data is subject to ODbL; attribution is retained in provider metadata.
datasets.projection: WGS84 provider coordinates transformed to each Sentinel-2 analysis CRS
datasets.transformation: Building nodes/centroids normalized to structure points
datasets.spatialJoinRule: Nearest archived site context; detector applies declared 150 m structure relationship
datasets.temporalJoinRule: Current 2026 snapshot held fixed during perturbation; no historical asset-state claim
knownLimitations: Current asset context cannot prove historical structure presence.
Asset-path stability is conditioned on this fixed snapshot.
datasets.referenceDependency: Independent volunteered map context; not authoritative building completeness or field truth.
datasets.qualification: Used for inspectable structure connectivity only, never as hazard ground truth.

datasets.provider: Element 84 Earth Search / AWS Sentinel-2 COG mirror
datasets.acquisitionMethod: STAC POST per frozen analysis group; provider feature responses archived and selected COGs range-read
datasets.licenseNotes: Public endpoint; upstream Copernicus Sentinel data terms apply.
datasets.projection: Native Sentinel-2 tile CRS warped to the frozen 256x256 analysis grid
datasets.transformation: Bilinear reflectance / nearest SCL resampling; identical detector pipeline
datasets.spatialJoinRule: 4 km bbox around each physical site; same MGRS grid preferred per pair
datasets.temporalJoinRule: Current alternative within 60 days before baseline current scene; prior alternative within ±60 days of baseline prior scene; before precedes after
knownLimitations: COG bytes are range-read rather than fully archived.
Seasonal windows are bounded but not phenologically identical.
Repeat-scene catalogue is a stability input, not external hazard truth.
datasets.referenceDependency: Same Sentinel-2 sensor family as the PREVENT detector; measures repeatability, not independent validity.
datasets.qualification: Real repeat-scene stability evidence with no human label claim.
